description: Index of the benchmark: for each case, the reference requirements (inputs), the published profile they led to (held-out reference) and the DCAT-AP release that profile extends (base). Hand-maintained. File integrity is in SHA256SUMS; counts are in cases/counts.json.

status_values.confirmed: RQ1 records this release and the specification states it.
status_values.consistent: RQ1 records the release or its source, and what RQ1 recorded about the requirements agrees with the stored files. The specification does not state the release.
status_values.rq1: Taken from RQ1, which is the standard here by the curator's instruction of 13 November 2026. The stored specification names a different release.

rq1.reference_document: Perego et al., Using DCAT-AP for research data (SDSVoc 2016, paper 27)

sources.title: Using DCAT-AP for research data (Perego, Friis-Christensen, Vaccari, Tsinaraki)
sources.note: Redistribution rights not established; no copy in this repository.

profile.evidence: First public specification of the profile the 2016 paper describes; its requirements section says part of them was described in that paper. No artefact from 2016 was found. Checked against RQ1 on 13 Nov 2026: all five terms RQ1 coded for the published rows and all four terms named in atom notes and anchors are in Version 1.

base.evidence: RQ1 records DCAT-AP 1.1 in the reference set and pins the registry dcat-ap-1.1.0 in every jrc-research run; the 2016 paper mentions 1.1 as the current DCAT-AP version. Version 1 of the specification lists DCAT-AP 1.2.1 (May 2019), GeoDCAT-AP 1.0.1 and StatDCAT-AP 1.0.1 as the specifications it is based on, so its difference to 1.1 also holds what DCAT-AP gained up to 1.2.1.

sources.title: StatDCAT-AP 1.0.0, development report and specification
sources.note: The same document is the requirement source and the profile specification.

profile.evidence: RQ1 pins this file at this commit; the title page gives version 1.0.0 and the date 2016-12-15.

base.evidence: Section 7.1 calls the profile an extension of DCAT-AP version 1.1.

sources.title: GeoDCAT-AP 1.0, specification
sources.note: The same document is the requirement source and the profile specification.

profile.evidence: RQ1 pins this file at this commit; every page footer reads GeoDCAT-AP v1.0, 2015-12-23.

base.evidence: RQ1 records DCAT-AP 1.1. The specification cites DCAT-AP as a 2015 document without a version number. It treats dct:provenance and dct:accessRights as DCAT-AP properties, and both are new in DCAT-AP 1.1. One mapping row marks foaf:page on a dataset as not in DCAT-AP, although DCAT-AP 1.1 added it.

sources.title: HealthData@EU Pilot, Deliverable 6.2: HealthDCAT-AP, recommendations on further development and deployment for possible EU-wide uptake

profile.evidence: D6.1 and D6.2 both give healthdcat-ap.github.io as the place where the profile is published. That site carried no version numbers, so the snapshot is the last commit of its repository on or before the D6.2 date (20 Sep 2024; the next one is 11 Oct 2024). The profile's own terms are the same in every commit from 29 Apr 2024 to the end of 2024. Checked against RQ1 on 13 Nov 2026: 31 of the 34 terms RQ1 coded for the published rows are in the snapshot; the other three (healthdcatap:reviewDate, proposed only; csvw:Schema; and, from atom notes, oa:bodyText and oa:motivation) are in D6.2 but in no state of the draft up to September 2025, so the choice of date does not affect them.
profile.alternative: Commit be9853dde202c6a573abfed4818c1963c1d2c426 (29 Apr 2024), the state one day before the D6.1 date. Not copied here.

base.evidence: RQ1 records DCAT-AP 3.0.0 in the reference set and pins the registry dcat-ap-3.0.0 in every healthdcat run; D6.2 refers to DCAT-AP 3.0 throughout. The draft says its requirements are compatible with DCAT-AP 2 and DCAT-AP 3.0.0 and shows one class diagram for each.

base.evidence: Section 1.3 says the DCAT-AP version the document is based on is 2.0.1 of 8 June 2020.

sources.note: The PDF in this folder is the copy the SEMIC repository serves; its document metadata is dated 2017-02-24. RQ1 builds its base from the archived final PDF of 2015 instead (bases/rq1-registries). The shapes in the two archives declare owl:versionInfo 1.2 (dcat-ap.shapes.ttl), which is why RQ1 does not use them. The archives are also unpacked next to them, bytes unchanged; the 2016 archive holds a .gitignore that is left out.

rq1_base_registries.description: The base registries the RQ1 workbench compares against, and the source of its DCAT-AP 1.1 registry. Every RQ1 run records the id and SHA-256 of its registry; the files here have those digests.
